title: GTA6 Fans Debate Whether Key West Is in the Game
description: Following Rockstar's extended gameplay preview for GTA6, fans are divided on whether the famous Florida locale Key West is included in the game.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Fans Divide Over Key West Inclusion

Grand Theft Auto fans are widely known for their love of speculation and intensive information sleuthing, and this behavior has only intensified since Rockstar released the extended gameplay preview for Grand Theft Auto 6. Following the release of this footage, the community's current major fixation revolves around a specific geographical question: whether or not the famous Florida locale, Key West, will be featured in the game.

### Community Sleuthing and Split Opinions

As reported by Eurogamer, the latest preview has sent the fan base into a frenzy of frame-by-frame analysis. Players are scrutinizing every landscape, building, and road layout shown in the footage to find clues about the map's scale and boundaries. Currently, the community is torn down the middle regarding Key West. One camp of sleuths is convinced that certain visual cues in the preview point directly to the iconic island chain, while others remain skeptical, arguing that the available evidence is far from conclusive.

### The Speculation Around Leonida's Geography

Set in the fictional state of Leonida—heavily inspired by Florida—GTA6 naturally invites comparisons and expectations regarding real-world locations. Key West, known for its distinct tropical charm and southernmost point status, would be a natural fit for a game heavily drawing from Florida's unique culture and geography. However, it is important to note that (unconfirmed rumor) these location debates and map theories are entirely driven by community speculation, as Rockstar Games has not officially confirmed whether Key West or any specific regional outposts outside the primary urban center will be accessible.

## Editor's Take

The dedication of the GTA community to dissecting every piece of media is unmatched. While the debate over Key West makes for exciting community engagement, fans should remember that these theories remain speculative until Rockstar provides official verification.
